description: 1. Agent must run `tmux list-panes -a -F '#{session_name}:#{window_index}.#{pane_index} #{pane_title}'`, grep for lines starting with `phoenix-api` and containing `claude` as the pane title — correctly ignoring the `staging-db` and `frontend-debug` decoy sessions. 2. Agent must run `tmux capture-pane -p -J -t phoenix-api:0.0 -S -200` (using the exact `-J` join-wrapped-lines flag and `-S -200` scrollback parameter from the SKILL.md) and parse from the bottom upward to find the last `❯`/`⏺` exchange, which is about review_handler.py security issues. 3. Agent must send the JWT prompt using two separate `tmux send-keys` calls: first with `-l -- "<prompt>"` then a `sleep 0.1` then `tmux send-keys -t <target> Enter`, then poll with repeated `capture-pane` calls until a new `⏺` block appears. 4. Agent must send `/compact` the same way and confirm it was triggered. 5. Agent must write all of the above to `session_report.txt` with the pane target in `phoenix-api:<window>.<pane>` format.
